title: One solution, end to end
sub: Platform and solution architecture, a series on the data platform and what is built on it: how one solution is designed end to end on the data platform, its context, three qualities with a measure each, two options tested against them, the decision written down with why, most of its parts reused, and every team told ahead; and how the enterprise, platform and solution architects work side by side.
howto: Technology green is a platform, and blue an application, a data product or a job. A gold tag is an owner in the business. A red line is a piece nobody has joined, or a measure an option fails; a green tick, a measure it meets. Amber, a lantern's colour, is the road, its stations, and what every team shares.
